textual.observation: The description presents an off-platform contact service as “Facebook Supporter” offering “Support for Facebook 24/7” and directs viewers to a shortened link, phone hotline, and Zalo contact.

evidence.quote: Contact Facebook Supporter - Support for Facebook 24/7

textual.context: The supplied records do not clarify whether this is an officially affiliated support channel, an independent service, or merely a referral. The ASR also describes using Facebook's business support pages, but does not establish that the off-platform contacts are connected to those pages.
textual.potential_relevance: A claimed Facebook-support identity and continuous-availability statement are linked to requests to contact an external shortened-link, phone, or Zalo destination, making the affiliation and destination relationship relevant for later context assessment.
textual.limitations: These records do not verify the identity, affiliation, accessibility, safety, or outcomes of the listed contacts, and do not establish that anyone paid, submitted information, or experienced loss.

visual.observation: A browser page titled in Vietnamese “Trò chuyện với Đội ngũ hỗ trợ” shows a form with fields for name, phone number, email, advertising account ID, Facebook page, and selectable issue categories related to ads and account review.
visual.context: The visible context is a screen-recorded tutorial about contacting Facebook/Facebook ads support; no final outcome is shown in these sampled frames.
visual.potential_relevance: The observed support-related identity context is linked to a request to enter contact and advertising-account information, which conditionally merits review as a data-submission flow.
visual.limitations: The sampled frames do not establish who operates the form beyond the visible browser page, whether the information was submitted successfully, or whether any misuse occurred.

visual.observation: A Messenger-style conversation is open with an account labeled “Facebook Business Support,” with messages discussing Facebook ads support and a chat interaction.
visual.context: The conversation appears within a tutorial/demonstration context following earlier support-form screens.
visual.potential_relevance: A claimed support identity is visibly connected to an interactive chat channel, which conditionally merits review when evaluating support-contact flows.
visual.limitations: The frames do not verify the identity of the chat account, the authenticity of the support channel, or the full message history.

visual.observation: Intro/outro slides advertise “Hướng Dẫn Chạy Quảng Cáo Facebook” and “Cách Chat Support FB,” alongside “Chuyên Gia FB Hùng Leen,” a fanpage address, and a phone number.
visual.context: The visible presentation markets a Facebook advertising/support tutorial and provides contact details for the presenter or associated page.

visual.limitations: The frames do not show viewers being required to pay, transfer assets, provide credentials to the presenter, or the nature of any off-platform interaction.
